summary: Consent and lawful basis are enforced through explicit opt-in mechanisms. The signup page (frontend/app/signup/page.tsx) and login page implement user authentication with session management. Post-verification test validates account verification. The CSP header restricts external connections to approved domains. TPS/CTPS screening data ensures leads respect do-not-contact preferences. The production README mandates that all commercial/unapproved paths default to false — explicit governance approval required for any capability. Cookie policy and privacy policy are publicly accessible.
assertions: TPS/CTPS screening data in leads/ directory
CSP enforces approved domains only (connect-src: api.stripe.com, *.sentry.io)
README: all commercial paths default to false until governance-approved
Cookie policy and privacy policy publicly accessible
